digest.component_or_area: backend neutrality gate and adapter architecture
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the reconciler package root because Data Center backend shares it with Cloud while story J7 seals the two concrete adapter packages against sibling imports
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 bidirectional seal between jira and jira_datacenter
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) cannot consume the jira_family layer
the backend neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py documents a permanent architectural cost of the J7 seal, not temporary relocation debt
the exemption comment must explain why the root location preserves both the adapter seal and the shared mapper pattern, without routing around the AST gate via path-string loads
